title: The 70% Problem - Agentic Engineering Glossary | AddyOsmani.com
summary: Addy Osmani's glossary entry: AI gets you most of the way fast, but edge cases, security and integration remain hard human work, shifting effort from writing to evaluating code.

assertions.quote: AI gets you 70% of the way fast. The remaining 30% is where experienced engineers earn their keep.
the hard part of software engineering was never typing the code
The craft shifts from writing code to evaluating code
AI excels at prototypes where the 70% is sufficient.
Structure, boilerplate, happy-path logic, standard patterns, CRUD operations, basic UI components - all handled well by AI
Junior developers who only know how to get the 70% are less valuable than senior engineers
